windows.notes:
Text is larger and easier to read on the computer. Nothing changes in the phone app.
- Computer: all text is larger, the smallest most of all.
- Computer: long folder paths wrap instead of pushing buttons off the window.
- Computer: the smallest window is a little taller, so the file list keeps its room.
